features.name: Source describes a typically concealed point in the handle

Two-handed long haft and broad alloy axe head with stowed handle end match generic primary description. Head shape, two grip regions and charcoal finish are explicit art choices; exact official shape not asserted. Actual matching clay is smooth of grip stippling/checkering, alloy grain, scratches, fine cuts and recesses. The large head reinforcement/socket, bevel, grip collars and end cap are major structural boundaries, not tiny ornamental cuts. Assigned sole reviewer inspected native/final independent masks, teal views and paired overlay. Full concave blade underside and both pointed blade ends, thin long haft and cap retained; no enclosed holes. Apparent white native-preview fragments are alpha1, invisible in actual teal and removed by the unchanged alpha-floor16 normalization; not opaque debris. No clipped point, missing member, detached foreground, broad fringe or cast shadow. Raw RGB unchanged; common crop/scale/offset only. 2048 output is resampled from1774x887, not native2K. Reference approval only.
